title: security: rbac v2 - fix KMS region pinning audit log gaps
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: RBAC v2 enforcement paths occasionally omitted the customer KMS region in audit payloads when requests were routed through policy variants. This caused gaps in audit logs for KMS key usage and made region-residency investigations difficult. This PR fixes two issues: (1) ensure the KMS region is captured and propagated in the audit logger payloads across policy evaluation and model-routing code paths, and (2) tighten the RBAC v2 policy evaluator to treat kms_region pinning as an enforcement constraint rather than advisory when the customer has 'enforce_residency' enabled. Changes include code fixes, unit tests, and a CI check to prevent regressions. Checklist: - [x] Add kms_region field to audit payloads emitted by services/audit-logger - [x] Ensure policy evaluator includes kms_region when building enforcement context - [x] Unit tests for region pinning scenarios (positive/negative) - [x] Add CI check to assert all audit events include kms_region when enforce flag is set - [x] Update docs and release notes Testing: Ran full unit test suite for services/audit-logger and services/rbac-v2; added new tests covering cross-region fallback and deny-on-mismatch semantics. Ran e2e in staging with a mocked KMS and verified audit events in the ELK pipeline include kms_region metadata for affected flows. Rollout plan: merge to main, deploy audit-logger and rbac-v2 services to staging, run smoke tests with production-like traffic, then schedule canary deploy to 10% for 24 hours before full rollout. Rollback: revert to previous commit and re-deploy services; CI tests will block re-merge until fixes are applied.

Aisha Patel (2025-09-04): Response: we added an explicit flag 'enforce_residency' on the tenant policy object. If not set, behavior remains advisory. Added a migration note to docs.

Aisha Patel (2025-09-07): Fixed fallback router to attach kms_region and added unit test; re-ran CI and all checks passed.
Laura Gomez (2025-09-08): Approve after a quick manual staging smoke test where audit events included kms_region for both direct and routed requests. Left minor nits about log formatting.
Michael Chen (2025-09-09): LGTM, verified added metrics and dashboard update for audit gaps. Approving for merge.
release_notes:
- Fix: RBAC v2 and audit-logger now consistently record KMS region (kms_region) in audit events.
- Change: kms_region pinning honored as an enforcement constraint when tenant policy has 'enforce_residency' enabled.
- Tests: added unit and integration tests; CI check prevents future regressions.
